ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, there is an external square border, and the internal gray figure is a cross-shaped dodecagon. The gray dodecagon is inscribed in the square, and the sides are all diagonal, forming a 45° direction with the horizontal and vertical sides of the square; in the direction of the upper side of the square, it can be regarded as being composed of 4 equal horizontal projections: the horizontal projection of the upper-left corner diagonal side, the horizontal projections of the two diagonal sides of the top notch, and the horizontal projection of the upper-right corner diagonal side. Reasoning: The perimeter of the dodecagon is 36 cm, and the dodecagon is equilateral, with 12 sides in total, so each side length s = 36/12 = 3 cm. Each diagonal side forms 45° with the horizontal side, therefore the horizontal projection of each side is s/√2 = 3/√2 cm. The side length of the square is equal to 4 such horizontal projections, so the side length is 4·(3/√2) = 6√2 cm. The area of the square is (6√2)^2 = 72 cm².

method.method_draft: Use a side-length/projection route. From the image, note that the grey dodecagon is inscribed in the square and its 12 equal sides run diagonally at 45 degrees to the square’s horizontal/vertical sides; along the top side of the square, the square width is made from four equal horizontal projections of dodecagon sides: left corner gap, two edges forming the top inward notch, and right corner gap. From the text, the dodecagon perimeter is 36 cm, so each of its 12 equal sides is s=36/12=3 cm. Since each diagonal side is the hypotenuse of a 45-45-90 triangle, its horizontal projection is s/sqrt(2). Therefore the square side length is 4s/sqrt(2)=2sqrt(2)s=6sqrt(2), and the square area is (6sqrt(2))^2=72.

method.method_draft: Use an area-decomposition route. From the image, view the grey cross-shaped dodecagon as a plus sign made from five congruent squares when aligned with the dodecagon’s sides: one central square and four arm squares, each with side equal to one dodecagon side s. The same picture shows the surrounding white space inside the outer square consists of four inward notch triangles and four corner triangles. From the text, s=36/12=3. The grey cross area is 5s^2. Each inward notch is a right isosceles triangle with legs s, so the four notches have total area 4(s^2/2)=2s^2. Each corner gap is a right isosceles triangle whose hypotenuse is a dodecagon side s, so each has area s^2/4, total s^2. Thus the whole square area is 5s^2+2s^2+s^2=8s^2=8*9=72.
